annotations.text:
The board, in the product's own kit.

The header carries the plan and its total spend. Four figures with their sources on the card: output tokens and turns from the agents' own session logs, bounces from the attempt records, held reviews from the stored review-held label and decision gates. Then spend by area, one tag per task from a list the plan declares once, so Planners cannot invent areas between sessions; then runway per provider; then what happened today, every recorded event in time order with what was written.

Every figure is a field lookup or arithmetic over fields. No text is read for meaning: a held review is the label the review gate writes, authors are the plan record's own titles, the log shows notes as written under their stored kind.

The area facet is the product's own tag mechanism, declared once per plan; no plan has declared one yet, so tonight's tasks are shown under the area their role suggests and the box says so. The tag-list sheet has the list and the command.

Cost and caching are measured, not estimated: 14 files, 60 MB, under half a second warm and 1.6 s cold; a day of sessions about 8 s; incremental reads under a second. The KPI ledger already ingests the same files behind per-file cursors and is off on this machine; the sheet says what it covers and the one column it lacks.
Every frame was rendered in headless Chrome and sized to its measured content before publishing. Values are lifted from tokens.css, globals.css and the usage panel's stylesheet.
